photoshoot.note: 4 shots per design, chosen to cover EVERY angle and detail of the ring (user directive 6 Sep 2026): front/top, 45-degree three-quarter, profile+inner band, and a macro detail. Together they show the face, both shoulders, the side height, the band and the stone setting. All 65 designs are MEN'S rings. Reference = media/designs/{SKU}.jpg. Shots are stamped with the Shivaa logo by tools/brand_logo.py. NO VIDEO — the site is photo-only (v42).
